mapper.select: /* 조직도 부서 트리 조회 (OrgchtMapper.selectOrgchtTree) */ WITH RECURSIVE root_dept AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info WHERE up_dept_no IS NULL ) = 1 THEN ( SELECT MAX(dept_no) FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info WHERE up_dept_no IS NULL ) ELSE 'B552894' END AS dept_no ), dept_tree AS ( SELECT d.dept_no ,CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(#{langSeCd}, 'ko')) = 'en' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.dept_eng_nm, ''), d.dept_nm) ELSE d.dept_nm END AS dept_nm ,d.up_dept_no ,d.dept_seq ,d.dept_no AS top_dept_no ,CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(#{langSeCd}, 'ko')) = 'en' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.dept_eng_nm, ''), d.dept_nm) ELSE d.dept_nm END AS top_dept_nm ,1 AS dept_level ,LPAD(COALESCE(d.dept_seq::text, '99999'), 5, '0') || '_' || d.dept_no AS sort_key FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info d JOIN root_dept r ON d.up_dept_no = r.dept_no UNION ALL SELECT c.dept_no ,CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(#{langSeCd}, 'ko')) = 'en' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dept_eng_nm, ''), c.dept_nm) ELSE c.dept_nm END AS dept_nm ,c.up_dept_no ,c.dept_seq ,p.top_dept_no ,p.top_dept_nm ,p.dept_level + 1 AS dept_level ,p.sort_key || '>' || LPAD(COALESCE(c.dept_seq::text, '99999'), 5, '0') || '_' || c.dept_no AS sort_key FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info c JOIN dept_tree p ON c.up_dept_no = p.dept_no ) SELECT top_dept_no ,top_dept_nm ,dept_no ,dept_nm ,up_dept_no ,dept_level ,dept_seq FROM dept_tree ORDER BY sort_key

/* 조직도 직원 조회 (OrgchtMapper.selectOrgchtEmployees) */ WITH RECURSIVE sub_dept AS ( SELECT d.dept_no ,d.dept_nm ,d.up_dept_no ,d.dept_seq ,LPAD(COALESCE(d.dept_seq::text, '99999'), 5, '0') || '_' || d.dept_no AS sort_key FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info d WHERE d.dept_no = #{deptNo} UNION ALL SELECT c.dept_no ,c.dept_nm ,c.up_dept_no ,c.dept_seq ,p.sort_key || '>' || LPAD(COALESCE(c.dept_seq::text, '99999'), 5, '0') || '_' || c.dept_no AS sort_key FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_dept_info c JOIN sub_dept p ON c.up_dept_no = p.dept_no ) SELECT e.emp_no ,e.emp_nm ,s.dept_no ,s.dept_nm ,e.jbgd_nm ,e.jbttl_nm ,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.jbttl_nm, ''), e.jbgd_nm) AS position_nm ,e.encpt_emp_telno ,e.encpt_emp_eml_nm ,e.main_task_cn ,e.emp_seq FROM sub_dept s JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info e ON e.dept_no = s.dept_no ORDER BY s.sort_key ,COALESCE(e.emp_seq, 99999) ,e.emp_no
